title: Sopa Paraguaya
description: Sopa Paraguaya is a dish from Paraguay featuring yellow onion, cornmeal, whole cow milk, queso fresco. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 10 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Layer the previously prepared components evenly inside a baking dish, serving mold or plate appropriate to the recipe; smooth the surface and avoid mixing the layers.
Bake the shaped or assembled mixture in a preheated oven for about 47 minutes until set and cooked through.
Serve the dish at the intended temperature and garnish as needed with previously prepared ingredients.
